h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Hospet

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Hospet

c: Hospet, also called Hosapete, is the base for most visitors to Hampi, and its hotels and resorts are a natural buyer for a small outdoor gym. A guest staying two or three nights still wants a morning workout. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to hotels, resorts, schools, mining township colonies and municipal parks in Hospet. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 590 km away, and reach Karnataka by road.

A hotel gym in the garden saves indoor space and looks tidy if the machines match the garden design. Our machines usually come in Play Orange and ocean grey, and we offer other roto-moulded colour shades on request. Our installation team or a dealer in south India fixes them on grouted or self-standing bases. Send us photos of the garden, and we will plan a compact gym corner with each station and its clear space marked on a layout drawing.

items.q: Can a hotel in Hospet have an outdoor gym in its garden?
items.a: Yes. A few machines in a garden corner give guests a place to exercise without using indoor space. We plan the layout so the gym fits around existing trees and paths.

items.q: Can the machines be installed on rocky ground?
items.a: Yes. Our team checks the ground and grouts each base into a concrete footing set to suit the rock. The layout drawing shows the exact position of every machine.

items.q: Can we choose colours to match our property?
items.a: Our standard colours include Play Orange and ocean grey, and we offer 15+ roto-moulded colour shades. Tell us your preference when you share the site details.
